participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Nurturing and caring, Emily is excited yet anxious about her first pregnancy. She tends to express her feelings openly and seeks support from others.
participant_1.background: Emily is a new mother living in Pennsylvania with her husband. She has recently started a new job as a personal assistant.

participant_2.name: Jessica
participant_2.personality: Supportive but sometimes confused, Jessica has a friendly demeanor. She tries to empathize with Emily's situation while navigating her own experiences as a mother.
participant_2.background: Jessica is a mother of a daughter and works as a veterinarian in the Midwest. She has been balancing her job and family life.
